issues_found.description: Root cause confirmed: 15 handoff files written by three out-of-band runs (ADHOC-prm-env-20260814, WF02-prm-batch2-20260814, WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815) on 2026-08-14/15 use a non-canonical schema keyed on agent_id/agent_name instead of from_agent/to_agent (H007 x30), carry completed_at values from local-time-labelled-Z clocks (H003 x5, H013 x5, all exactly 5.0h offset), left step-02a IN_PROGRESS while 7 later steps COMPLETED (H009 x1), and 71 handoffs are absent from handoffs/registry.json (H010 MINOR).

ADHOC-prm-env-20260814/step-00-backend-dev.json contains a duplicate top-level 'completed_at' key (first 'completed_at': null, then 'completed_at': '2026-08-14T14:39:42Z'); json.loads keeps the last value, which is what produces its H003/H013 pair. The null first value is the anomaly that a future schema fix should clean, but per this run's disposition the finding is acknowledged-in-baseline, not corrected.

After the H010 repair script backfills the 67 backfillable handoffs, 4 will remain registry-absent and non-backfillable: ADHOC-prm-env-20260814/step-00-backend-dev.json, WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815/step-04-issue-fixer.json, WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815/step-04-test-runner-rework4.json (all 3 missing from_agent/to_agent — the agent_id/agent_name schema), and WF02-iss201-event-return-20260611/step-final-backend-dev.json (missing created_at; NOT one of this run's 42 findings — a separate pre-existing debt). Residual H010 stays MINOR and does NOT red the gate (exit code is 1 only when BLOCKER or MAJOR remain).

next_steps: ORCH routes to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3) to implement the fix per the fix_spec_for_step3 below. Step 2 (CODE-DESIGNER) produces the design artefact from this diagnosis before Step 3.

root_cause.refinement: Step 0.5's diagnosis (ISS-0709) is CONFIRMED against the actual files. Refinement added: (1) the H003/H013 pair on ADHOC-prm-env-20260814/step-00-backend-dev.json is caused by a DUPLICATE 'completed_at' key (null then value) whose last value wins under json.loads; (2) the H013 offset is uniformly 5.0h across all 5 files, consistent with a single 2026-08-14 session whose operator used (Get-Date).ToString(...) without .ToUniversalTime() (UTC+5); (3) exactly 4 of the 71 registry-absent handoffs are non-backfillable by the repair script, 3 of which are this run's agent_id-schema files; (4) the H007 x30 findings all share one root cause — the out-of-band runs wrote handoffs using agent_id/agent_name (the subagent-invocation vocabulary) instead of from_agent/to_agent (the handoff-schema vocabulary) — a distinct schema-variant reason not covered by the existing H007-gh387-step07 / H007-gh389-step2b baseline reasons.
root_cause.prior_art_note: Per ISS-0709.investigation_notes: H013 correction was REJECTED in ISS-0627/GH-596 and folded into the acknowledgment mechanism; H003/H009 are permanent-record categories (no field recovers the true value); H010 was repaired in WF03-GH594-20260808 by registry backfill. This run follows that prior art: acknowledge-in-baseline for the 41 (incl. H007, which prior runs corrected where the file is a real handoff but which this run's fix spec chooses to acknowledge per the task instruction), and registry backfill for H010.

fix_spec_for_step3.scope: Step 3 (BACKEND-DEV) implements ONLY the two operations below. Do NOT correct the underlying handoff files, do NOT regenerate the baseline via tools/generate_lint_handoffs_baseline.py, do NOT fabricate timestamps/status values.

part_a_baseline_append.method: Append 41 entries to the existing top-level 'issues' array by hand (Python script, json load with encoding='utf-8', dump with ensure_ascii=False, indent=2). NEVER run tools/generate_lint_handoffs_baseline.py --apply: it only emits the H003/H004/H005/H009 subset and would silently drop the 53 H013 + 9 H007 entries already present (same trap recorded in the 2026-08-10 GH-666 append note).
part_a_baseline_append.preserve_all_existing: All 291 existing entries (148 H003, 36 H004, 6 H005, 39 H009, 9 H007, 53 H013) MUST remain byte-unchanged. Only the additions below are made.
part_a_baseline_append.header_updates: Update top-level 'generated_at' to the append timestamp (python tools/utcnow.py output at Step 3 time) and append a dated note to 'regeneration_note' recording the 42-finding acknowledgment append (WF03-lintdebt-20260816 / GH #796 / ISS-0709), mirroring the GH-666 append precedent. Do not overwrite existing regeneration_note text.

new_reason_key.text: ISS-0709 §H007 (WF03-lintdebt-20260816 / GH #796): out-of-band runs ADHOC-prm-env-20260814, WF02-prm-batch2-20260814, WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815 (2026-08-14/15) wrote handoff files using the non-canonical schema keys agent_id/agent_name instead of the required from_agent/to_agent. The files are legitimate routed handoffs whose true from_agent/to_agent values are recoverable (agent_id maps directly to from_agent/to_agent of the same step), but correcting 15 historical files would require rewriting audit-trail records; this run's disposition (per WF-03 task instruction) is permanent acknowledgment of the 30 H007 findings as historical record, not correction. Accepted as permanent historical record.

part_a_baseline_append.acknowledged_at: python tools/utcnow.py output at Step 3 append time

part_b_h010_repair.method: Run: python tools/repair_handoff_bookkeeping.py --category h010 --dry-run --now $(python tools/utcnow.py)  (review), then --apply --now $(python tools/utcnow.py). The script is purely additive (never removes/mutates existing registry entries) and self-verifying; it requires --now when applying.
part_b_h010_repair.expected_outcome: Backfills the 67 backfillable registry-absent handoffs. 4 remain absent and non-backfillable (see issues_found): the 3 agent_id-schema files of this run + WF02-iss201-event-return-20260611/step-final-backend-dev.json (missing created_at, separate pre-existing debt).
part_b_h010_repair.residual_h010: After repair, lint_handoffs reports H010 as MINOR with the residual count (4 of 2916, 0.1%). MINOR findings do NOT red the gate (main() returns 1 only when BLOCKER or MAJOR remain), so exit code becomes 0. Do NOT append an H010 entry to the baseline for the residual: the H010 message embeds the live count/percentage, so a baseline key would go stale on every registry change. The residual-4 state is acceptable, non-gating, and documented; a follow-up (schema normalization of the 3 agent_id files to permit registry backfill + created_at resolution for the iss201 file) is tracked in this report's issues_found.
